metadata.title: Stable ample vector bundles without semipositive Kobayashi curvature
metadata.abstract: We construct slope-stable ample rank-two vector bundles on every Hirzebruch surface $\mathbb{F}_e$ that admit no smooth strongly pseudoconvex Finsler metric with semipositive Kobayashi curvature. These examples give a negative answer to Kobayashi's problem. The same bundles give counterexamples to the smooth strongly pseudoconvex Finsler formulation of Fulton's problem and to the Hartshorne--Schneider conjecture on the convexity of complements. For $e=1$, these counterexamples have a simply connected Fano base that is not a product.
